fields.name: firm_id
fields.description: Firm.

fields.name: measurement_status
fields.description: ranked or listed_separately.

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Rank on the central headline figure (ranked firms). Neighbouring firms' ranges often overlap; see rank_range_best and rank_range_worst.

fields.name: consistency_adjusted_value_per_dollar
fields.description: Headline figure (x).

fields.name: adjusted_low
fields.description: Headline at the low end of the range from estimated inputs.

fields.name: adjusted_high
fields.description: Headline at the high end of the range from estimated inputs.

fields.name: rank_range_best
fields.description: Best rank across the input range and the 19 alternative specifications.

fields.name: rank_range_worst
fields.description: Worst rank across the input range and the 19 alternative specifications.

fields.name: value_per_dollar
fields.description: V / K: primary value at the end date divided by capital at risk (x).

fields.name: value_per_dollar_low
fields.description: value_per_dollar at the low end of the range.

fields.name: value_per_dollar_high
fields.description: value_per_dollar at the high end of the range.

fields.name: rank_value_per_dollar
fields.description: Rank on plain value per dollar among ranked firms.

fields.name: value_per_dollar_beyond_largest
fields.description: (V - V_top) / K, where V_top is the primary value of the largest company (x).

fields.name: beyond_largest_low
fields.description: value_per_dollar_beyond_largest at the low end of the range.

fields.name: beyond_largest_high
fields.description: value_per_dollar_beyond_largest at the high end of the range.

fields.name: adjusted_one_fifth_weight
fields.description: Headline with a fifth of the weight on depth.

fields.name: adjusted_half_weight
fields.description: Headline with half the weight on depth (version 5 headline).

fields.name: adjusted_beyond_two_largest
fields.description: Headline with depth measured beyond the two largest companies.

fields.name: value_primary_usd_bn
fields.description: V: sum of holdings.primary_value_counted_usd_bn over the firm's core venture lines. Unit: USD bn.

fields.name: capital_at_risk_usd_bn
fields.description: K: sum of fund_vehicles.capital_at_risk_usd_m over the firm's in-scope vehicles, in billions. Unit: USD bn.

fields.name: companies
fields.description: Number of listings with primary value.

fields.name: largest_company_listing_id
fields.description: Listing with the largest primary value.

fields.name: largest_company_share
fields.description: Share of V from the largest company.

fields.name: could_fall_over_30pct
fields.description: True if the headline would fall by more than 30% at the low end of the range (marked with a diamond in the report).

fields.name: capital_low_confidence_share
fields.description: Share of K resting on low-confidence fund sizes.

fields.name: value_estimated_share
fields.description: Share of V resting on estimated stakes.

fields.name: mean_year_capital_at_risk
fields.description: Capital-weighted mean year in which capital at risk was drawn.

fields.name: rank_vs_qqq
fields.description: Rank on the annualised measure against the QQQ.

fields.name: direct_alpha_vs_median_firm
fields.description: Adjusted Direct Alpha minus the median ranked firm's (fraction per year).

fields.name: direct_alpha_vs_qqq_adjusted
fields.description: Direct Alpha against the Nasdaq-100 (QQQ) on the adjusted value (fraction per year).

fields.name: pme_vs_qqq_adjusted
fields.description: Kaplan-Schoar public market equivalent on the adjusted value (x).

fields.name: irr_adjusted
fields.description: Internal rate of return on the adjusted value (fraction per year).

fields.name: direct_alpha_vs_qqq_unadjusted
fields.description: Direct Alpha on the plain value (fraction per year).

fields.name: pme_vs_qqq_unadjusted
fields.description: Kaplan-Schoar PME on the plain value (x).

fields.name: irr_unadjusted
fields.description: Internal rate of return on the plain value (fraction per year).

fields.name: rank_total_value_all_core
fields.description: Rank on primary value among all core venture holders.

fields.name: rank_stage_weighted_all_core
fields.description: Rank on stage-weighted value among all core venture holders.

fields.name: rank_ex_spacex
fields.description: Rank with SpaceX excluded (a different question, shown separately).

fields.name: reason_not_ranked
fields.description: Why a firm listed separately is not ranked.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Changes and judgments behind the firm's figures.
